messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.Name: Dynamic Variable Power Tools
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.Description: This mod adds a variety of powerful functions to dynamic variables and their spaces.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.DebugInfoGener: Adds buttons to DynamicVariableSpace components in inspectors based on the Debug Info settings that allow generating debug information for the space.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.OpenLinkedDyna: Adds buttons to the header of linked dynamic variable components in inspectors that allow opening the space they're linked to.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.RenameDirectly: Adds a button to DynamicVariableSpace components in inspectors that allows renaming the space together with all linked variables.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.RenameDynamicV: Adds a button to dynamic variable components in inspectors that allows renaming all linked instances of that variable.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.DynamicVariabl: Adds options to set up dynamic variable components to the Member Actions context menu for fields in inspectors. Uses the Member Actions settings.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.Config.RenameO: Options for the renaming of dynamic variables and their spaces.
Search and rename ProtoFlux inputs with the old name in the form OldName/* (Experimental).
Show rename action on dynamic variable components.
Show rename action on DynamicVariableSpace components.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.Config.DebugIn: Adds a button to DynamicVariableSpace components in inspectors that allows generating a list of all dynamic variable definitions linked to that space.
Adds a button to DynamicVariableSpace components in inspectors that allows generating a hierarchical list of all dynamic variable components linked to a space.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.Config.MemberA:
Allow downcasting the type of the dynamic variable to the type required by the target reference.

Downcasting means that the variable's type is more specific than the target reference's - for example assigning a SkinnedMeshRenderer variable to a MeshRenderer reference. This will always be successful.

Allow upcasting the type of the dynamic variable to the type required by the target reference.

Upcasting means that the variable's type is less specific than the target reference's - for example trying to assign a MeshRenderer variable to a SkinnedMeshRenderer reference. This will only work if the current value of the dynamic variable is actually a SkinnedMeshRenderer; otherwise, the target reference will be set to null.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.EnableLinkedVa: Generates a list of all dynamic variable definitions linked to this space in the Output field.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.EnableLinkedCo: Generates a hierarchical list of all dynamic variable components linked to this space in the Output field.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.RenameDirectly: Rename this space and all linked variables.
messages.DynamicVariablePowerTools.RenameDynamicV: Rename all linked instances of this variable.
